# ionhour_check (Data Source)

Look up an Ionhour check by `id` or `slug` (exactly one).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ionhour_check" "public_api" {
  slug = "public-api"
}

output "public_api_status" {
  value = data.ionhour_check.public_api.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric check id. Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.
- `slug` (String) Check slug. Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.

### Read-Only

- `check_type` (String) Probe type. Only `HTTP` is managed through the API in v1.
- `config` (Attributes) Probe configuration; null for a check without a live probe config. HTTP-only keys are null for other check types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `down_severity` (String) Incident severity when the monitor goes DOWN (`P1`-`P4`).
- `grace_seconds` (Number) Grace period in seconds (5-60).
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Probe interval in seconds (10-3600, plan floor applies).
- `late_severity` (String) Incident severity when the monitor goes LATE (`P1`-`P4`).
- `mute_notifications` (Boolean) Suppress notifications. Setting `true` on a check is plan-gated.
- `name` (String) Check name.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is paused (status `PAUSED`). Pause and resume are not managed by Terraform.
- `project_id` (Number) Project the monitor belongs to. Changing it moves the monitor in place (same id).
- `status` (String) Current status: `NEW`, `OK`, `LATE`, `DOWN`, `PAUSED` or `RESUMED`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339, UTC).

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Read-Only:

- `block_http_downgrade` (Boolean) Fail when a redirect downgrades HTTPS to HTTP.
- `body_contains` (String) Pass only if the response body contains this text (case-insensitive, at most 1000 characters). Plan-gated.
- `body_not_contains` (String) Fail if the response body contains this text (case-insensitive, at most 1000 characters). Plan-gated.
- `custom_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Request headers (names lowercased). Sensitive.
- `expected_status_max` (Number) Highest passing HTTP status, inclusive (100-599).
- `expected_status_min` (Number) Lowest passing HTTP status, inclusive (100-599). Must not exceed `expected_status_max`.
- `fail_after_consecutive` (Number) Consecutive failures before the check goes DOWN (1-10).
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) Follow redirects.
- `ip_family` (String) IP family the probe uses (`AUTO`, `IPV4`, `IPV6`). Read-only.
- `latency_warn_ms` (Number) Latency alert threshold in milliseconds. Removing it disables the alert. Plan-gated.
- `max_redirects` (Number) Maximum redirects to follow (0-3).
- `max_response_bytes` (Number) Largest response body the probe reads, in bytes. Read-only.
- `method` (String) HTTP method: `GET`, `HEAD`, `POST`, `PUT` or `PATCH`.
- `regions` (Set of String) Probe region ids.
- `resolve_after_consecutive_success` (Number) Consecutive successes before an incident resolves (1-10).
- `skip_tls_verification` (Boolean) Whether TLS verification is skipped. Read-only.
- `ssl_expiry_warn_days` (Number) TLS certificate expiry alert threshold in days (1-365). Setting a non-default value is plan-gated.
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Probe timeout in milliseconds (1000-15000).
- `url` (String) Target URL.
